audit_items.proof_trace: Both `debts_value_usd_non_liquidation` (L1198) and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` (L1284) call `get_price_with_check()` with per-asset `ema_spot_tolerance`, which asserts `abs(ema-spot)/spot <= tolerance` and aborts on violation. `is_obligation_safe` (L1214-1249) invokes both and is called on every `handle_borrow` (L424) and `handle_withdraw` (L332) — no bypass path exists. The liquidation path intentionally uses EMA-only pricing for threshold checks (manipulation-resistant) and spot pricing for seize-amount ratios, which is by design and does not expose the overborrowing risk this property guards against.
